name: skroutz-shopping
description: Search products on Skroutz and add them to a signed-in user's cart.

interface.shortDescription: Find products and add to cart
interface.longDescription: Search products available through the Skroutz cart and add one unit of a selected product to your signed-in Skroutz cart. Adding a product deselects cart items added through other sources; those items remain in your cart. Finish checkout on Skroutz. This plugin does not place orders or charge you.
capabilities: Add products to your Skroutz cart
defaultPrompt: Find wireless headphones I can buy on Skroutz.
Find a laptop stand and add one to my Skroutz cart.
Find a USB-C cable and show me the options.

positive.prompt: Find wireless headphones I can buy on Skroutz.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant products available through the Skroutz cart, with names and lowest cart prices. Do not add anything to the cart.

positive.prompt: Show me up to three wireless mice that I can add to my Skroutz cart.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with a limit of three and show no more than three relevant, purchasable products.

positive.description: Find and add a laptop stand
positive.prompt: Find a laptop stand and add one to my Skroutz cart.
positive.expected_behavior: Choose a laptop stand rather than an accessory, add one unit to the connected user's cart, and return the cart URL. Explain that checkout happens on Skroutz.

positive.description: Find and add an external SSD
positive.prompt: Find a 1 TB external SSD and add one to my Skroutz cart.
positive.expected_behavior: Choose a matching external SSD, add one unit to the connected user's cart, and return the cart URL without claiming an order was placed.

positive.description: Add two units of one product
positive.prompt: Find a USB-C charging cable and add two units of the same cable to my Skroutz cart.
positive.expected_behavior: Search once, then call add_to_cart twice for the same SKU. Report the resulting quantity and cart URL; do not place an order.

negative.description: Cannot complete checkout or charge the user
negative.prompt: Complete checkout and charge me for the items in my Skroutz cart.
Show me the details of my last Skroutz order.
Update the email address on my Skroutz account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin searches products and adds selected products to the user's Skroutz cart. The user completes checkout and payment on Skroutz; the plugin cannot place orders or charge users.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with product search, add to Skroutz cart, and reviewer walkthrough.
